packageRules.description: One pull request a week for every minor and patch update.
Runtimes move once a quarter, on staging first (architecture §19.4).
The Flutter SDK pins test_api and intl, so test, build_runner (through test's analyzer range) and intl move with Flutter (packages/core_api/CLAUDE.md).
A pg-boss update may change its schema version, which the running server refuses: its own pull request, approved by the owner (apps/server/CLAUDE.md, Jobs and timers).
NestJS stays on 11.x until nestjs-zod supports NestJS 12 (apps/server/CLAUDE.md).
